rules: Auth middleware change → test full sign-in flow in browser before marking done — auth bugs are invisible until a real session is created
Email route change → verify delivery in a real inbox (not just a console.log) before marking done
Billing or webhook route change → test with Stripe test mode first; never test a change against live keys first
Schema change → run migrate deploy on a staging copy first; never edit a migration file that has already been applied to production
Any change to session/cookie handling → test with a fresh browser (no existing cookies) — most auth bugs only appear on first login
_comment: Starter for Next.js web apps. Edit pipeline_files to match your actual paths. Rules are universally valid — add project-specific rules as incidents occur.
